Add an entry = add an object; every entry cites the decision it comes from.

allow._decision: A hit is allowed only when it sits inside a current paste_1b content string: the whole text node equals that string, or the string is 12+ characters long and covers the hit. Content = cards (every string field), verses, jesusWords, jesusWordsFallback, soundDuel. UI-chrome keys (uiText, encouragement, rewardText, wrongText, welcomeBack, gotItText, restScreen) are not allow sources.
